system_texts: The product will be a universal remote control capable of operating TV and other devices (including VCR and DVD) and will be designed as a black device with several buttons.
The design work will consist of three phases: functional design, conceptual design, and detailed design.

The group decided to set the selling price of the remote control at about twenty-five Euros, and to target a profit of fifty million Euros by targeting a large European market, and the remote control must be original, trendy, and user-friendly.
The group aims to achieve a profit of fifty million Euros by targeting a large European market.
The team proposed to offer the rechargeable recharger as a separate option and to sell it separately.
gold_texts: The group decided to make the remote a universal remote.
The remote will not have a touch screen, because it would be too expensive and too fragile.
